exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: miss, keep, make, season's, heavy, decorate, enjoy

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  'to' dan keyin → FE'L (decorate, enjoy, make, keep)
  ot oldida      → SIFAT yoki EGALIK (heavy, season's)
  ega + ...      → FE'L (miss)

Barcha iboralar 49-betdagi uchta otkritkadan olingan.

items.whyUz:
'to decorate the Christmas tree' = archani bezamoq (B otkritka).
Gap: They are decorating the Christmas tree.

'We miss you a lot' = sizni juda sog'indik (B otkritka).
Ko'plik ega ('we') → fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.

'to enjoy the good weather' = yaxshi ob-havodan zavqlanmoq (C otkritka).
Gap: Everyone is enjoying the good weather.

'Season's greetings' = bayram tabriklari (C otkritka).
Egalik apostrofi: season + 's.

'heavy jackets' = qalin kurtkalar (A otkritka).
'heavy' bu yerda = qalin, issiq (og'ir emas).

'to make a snowman' = qorbobo yasamoq (A otkritka).
Gap: They are making a snowman in the park.

'to keep them warm' = ularni issiq saqlamoq (A otkritka).
Bu ibora 40-betdagi pingvin matnida ham bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in on, in, at, of or from.
exercises.instructionUz: on, in, at, of yoki from predloglarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR — ASOSIY QOIDALAR:

  IN — ichida: shahar, bog', xona, kiyim
       in Warsaw, in the park, in their pyjamas
  ON — yuzasida: plyaj, ko'cha, devor, muz
       on the beach, on the wall
  AT — aniq nuqta yoki vaqt:
       at the moment, at 5 o'clock, at home
  FROM — kelib chiqish nuqtasi:
       Greetings from London
  OF — egalik yoki tarkib:
       Lots of love, a lot of people

DIQQAT — SHAHAR va PLYAJ:
  IN Warsaw (shahar ICHIDA)
  ON the beach (plyaj YUZASIDA)

items.whyUz:
Shahar, mamlakat, mahalla → IN.
'It is cold IN Warsaw.'

Bog', o'rmon, xona → IN.
'They are making a snowman IN the park.'
'AT the moment' = ayni paytda — o'zgarmas ibora.
'Greetings FROM ...' = ...dan salom. Kelib chiqish nuqtasi → FROM.

'be IN + kiyim' = kiygan holda bo'lmoq.
'The children are IN their pyjamas.'

'ON the beach' — plyaj yuzasida turibdi → ON.
DIQQAT: 'in the beach' XATO.

'Lots OF love' = katta mehr bilan.
'lots of', 'a lot of' — miqdor iboralari doim OF bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at today's international weather chart. Symbols and temperature scale.
exercises.instructionUz: Bugungi xalqaro ob-havo jadvaliga qarang. Belgilar va harorat shkalasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
OB-HAVO BELGILARI (Symbols):
  bulut           = cloudy  (bulutli)
  puflab turgan bulut = windy (shamolli)
  bulut va tomchilar  = rainy (yomg'irli)
  quyosh          = sunny   (quyoshli)
  bulut va qor    = snowy   (qorli)

HARORAT SHKALASI (sovuqdan issiqqa):
  freezing cold  −5°C / 23°F   — qattiq sovuq
  cold            5°C / 41°F   — sovuq
  chilly         10°C / 50°F   — salqin (sovuqroq)
  cool           15°C / 59°F   — salqin (yoqimli)
  warm           25°C / 77°F   — iliq
  hot            30°C / 86°F   — issiq
  boiling hot    35°C / 95°F   — juda issiq

HARORAT BIRLIKLARI:
  °C = degrees Celsius   (Selsiy darajasi)
  °F = degrees Fahrenheit (Farengeyt darajasi)
  Britaniya va Yevropa °C, AQSH esa °F ishlatadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at today's international weather chart. Ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Bugungi xalqaro ob-havo jadvaliga qarang. Namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: What's the weather like in Cairo today?
  S2: It's warm and sunny.
  S1: What's the temperature in Cairo today?
  S2: It's 25°C. / It's 77°F.

IKKI SAVOL:
  What's the weather LIKE ...?  → sifat bilan javob
  What's the TEMPERATURE ...?   → daraja bilan javob

JADVAL:
  Cairo     quyosh  25 / 77
  London    shamol  10 / 50
  Madrid    bulut    5 / 41
  Manila    quyosh  30 / 86
  Paris     yomg'ir  5 / 41
  Prague    qor     −5 / 23
  Rome      bulut   15 / 59
  Singapore quyosh  35 / 95

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. 25°C = warm, belgi = quyosh.
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
10°C shkalada 'chilly' ga to'g'ri keladi; belgi shamolni bildiradi.
Jadvalda: London 10 C / 50 F.
5°C shkalada 'cold'; belgi oddiy bulut → cloudy.
Jadvalda: Madrid 5 C / 41 F.
30°C shkalada 'hot'; belgi quyosh → sunny.
Jadvalda: Manila 30 C / 86 F.
5°C shkalada 'cold'; belgi yomg'ir tomchilari → rainy.
Jadvalda: Paris 5 C / 41 F — Madrid bilan bir xil harorat, lekin ob-havo boshqa.

−5°C shkalada 'freezing cold'; belgi qor → snowy.
Bu — jadvaldagi eng sovuq shahar.

Jadvalda: Prague −5 C / 23 F.
Manfiy harorat: 'minus five degrees' deb o'qiladi.
15°C shkalada 'cool'; belgi oddiy bulut → cloudy.
Jadvalda: Rome 15 C / 59 F.

35°C shkalada 'boiling hot'; belgi quyosh → sunny.
Bu — jadvaldagi eng issiq shahar.
Jadvalda: Singapore 35 C / 95 F.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the activities in the list can you do when it is: snowy? hot and sunny? cold and rainy?
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi mashg'ulotlardan qaysilarini qorli, issiq-quyoshli yoki sovuq-yomg'irli ob-havoda qilish mumkin?
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: go to the beach, make a snowman, go on a picnic,
         watch TV, go swimming, sunbathe, read a book, ski

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  When it is snowy you can ski or make a snowman.

QOLIP: When it is + ob-havo, you can + fe'l (+ or + fe'l).

DIQQAT: 'when' — vaqt bog'lovchisi, ergash gapni boshlaydi.

UYDA QILINADIGAN ISHLAR (watch TV, read a book) har qanday
ob-havoda mumkin — ayniqsa yomon ob-havoda.

items.answer: When it is snowy you can ski or make a snowman. You can also watch TV or read a book.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna: 'When it is snowy you can ski or make a snowman.'
'to ski' = chang'i uchmoq.

items.textEn: HOT AND SUNNY (issiq va quyoshli) — nima qilish mumkin?
items.answer: When it is hot and sunny you can go to the beach, go on a picnic, go swimming or sunbathe.

items.textEn: COLD AND RAINY (sovuq va yomg'irli) — nima qilish mumkin?
items.answer: When it is cold and rainy you can watch TV or read a book.
items.whyUz: Yomg'irda tashqariga chiqib bo'lmaydi — uy ichidagi mashg'ulotlar qoladi.

exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous — tasdiq va inkor shakllari.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozirgi davomli zamon)

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
  I           AM     playing
  you         ARE    playing
  he/she/it   IS     playing
  we/you/they ARE    playing

INKOR (Negative):
  I           'M NOT  playing
  you         AREN'T  playing
  he/she/it   ISN'T   playing
  we/you/they AREN'T  playing

QOLIP: ega + to be + fe'l + ING

QACHON ISHLATILADI:
  HOZIR, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun.

VAQT SO'ZLARI:
  now (hozir), at present (hozirda), at the moment (ayni paytda)

MISOLLAR:
  She's playing football now.
  She isn't eating an ice-cream at the moment.

O'ZBEKCHADA: '-yapti' qo'shimchasi bilan beriladi.
  She is playing → U o'ynayapti

points.en: I am playing. / I'm not playing.
points.noteUz: 'I' bilan faqat AM. Inkori: I'm not ('I amn't' YO'Q so'z).

points.en: You are playing. / You aren't playing.
He is playing. / He isn't playing.
She is playing. / She isn't playing.
It is playing. / It isn't playing.
We are playing. / We aren't playing.
They are playing. / They aren't playing.
She isn't eating an ice-cream at the moment.
points.noteUz: Kitobdagi namuna. 'at the moment' — Present Continuous belgisi.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table, then complete the rule.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDA (bo'shliq bilan):
  'To form the present continuous we use the verb "to be"
   and add ............ to the base form of the main verb.'

  = Present Continuous yasash uchun 'to be' fe'lini ishlatamiz
    va asosiy fe'lning asos shakliga ............ qo'shamiz.

items.textEn: To form the present continuous we use the verb "to be" and add ............ to the base form of the main verb.
items.whyUz:
Jadvalda 'playING' — demak asos fe'lga -ING qo'shiladi.
To'liq qolip: to be + fe'l + -ing.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts in Ex. 7 again and fill in the -ing form of the verbs in the table below, then complete the rules.
exercises.instructionUz: 7-mashqdagi matnlarni qayta o'qing va quyidagi jadvalga fe'llarning -ing shaklini yozing, so'ng qoidalarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
-ING QO'SHISHNING UCH QOIDASI:

  1) KO'PCHILIK FE'LLAR — shunchaki -ing qo'shiladi
       snow → snowing,  wear → wearing,
       rain → raining,  enjoy → enjoying

  2) BITTA URG'ULI UNLI + BITTA UNDOSH bilan tugasa —
     UNDOSH IKKILANADI
       swim → swiMMing,  run → ruNNing,  sit → siTTing
     Sabab: unli qisqa qolishi kerak.

  3) -E bilan tugasa — E TUSHADI
       make → makIng,  decorate → decoratIng,
       shine → shinIng,  write → writIng

DIQQAT: 'enjoy' -y bilan tugasa ham -ing oddiy qo'shiladi
(y dan oldin UNLI bor: enjOY).

items.whyUz:
1-qoida: oddiy -ing qo'shiladi.
49-betdagi A otkritkada: 'It is snowing heavily today.'

1-qoida: oddiy -ing.
A otkritkada: 'the children are wearing their heavy jackets'.

1-qoida: oddiy -ing.
B otkritkada: 'it is raining'.

1-qoida: oddiy -ing.
DIQQAT: -ing oldidan 'y' HECH QACHON 'i' ga aylanmaydi.
C otkritkada: 'enjoying the good weather'.

2-qoida: bitta urg'uli unli (i) + bitta undosh (m) → M IKKILANADI.
C otkritkada: 'Everyone is swimming'.

3-qoida: -E bilan tugaydi → E TUSHADI.
A va C otkritkalarda: 'making a snowman', 'making a sandcastle'.

3-qoida: -E TUSHADI.
B otkritkada: 'decorating the Christmas tree'.

3-qoida: -E TUSHADI.
C otkritkada: 'the sun is shining'.

items.textEn: QOIDA: Verbs ending in one stressed vowel and a consonant double the consonant and take ............ .
items.whyUz: swim → swimm + ING = swimming.

items.textEn: QOIDA: Verbs ending in -e drop the e and take ............ .
items.whyUz: make → mak + ING = making.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the short answers in this table.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQ SHAKLI (Interrogative):
  'be' fe'li EGADAN OLDIN chiqadi:
     Am I playing?    Are you playing?
     Is he playing?   Are they playing?

QISQA JAVOB QOIDASI:
  Yes, + ega + to'liq 'be' shakli.   (qisqartma YO'Q!)
  No,  + ega + qisqargan inkor shakli.

  TO'G'RI: Yes, I am.      XATO: Yes, I'm.
  TO'G'RI: No, I'm not.

JADVAL TO'LIQ HOLDA:
  Am I playing?      → Yes, I am.      / No, I'm not.
  Are you playing?   → Yes, you are.   / No, you aren't.
  Is he playing?     → Yes, he is.     / No, he isn't.
  Is she playing?    → Yes, she is.    / No, she isn't.
  Is it playing?     → Yes, it is.     / No, it isn't.
  Are we playing?    → Yes, we are.    / No, we aren't.
  Are you playing?   → Yes, you are.   / No, you aren't.
  Are they playing?  → Yes, they are.  / No, they aren't.

items.textEn: Am I playing? — Yes, I am. / No, ............
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN: 'Yes, I am./No, I'm not.'
'I amn't' — ingliz tilida YO'Q shakl.

items.textEn: Are you playing? — Yes, you are. / No, ............
items.whyUz: 'aren't' = are not. To'liq shakli ham to'g'ri: 'you are not'.

items.textEn: Is he playing? — Yes, ............ / No, he isn't.
items.whyUz:
'Yes, he is.' — 'Yes, he's' XATO.
Qisqa tasdiq javobda 'be' TO'LIQ yoziladi.

items.textEn: Is she playing? — Yes, she is. / No, ............
items.whyUz: 'isn't' = is not.

items.textEn: Is it playing? — Yes, it is. / No, ............
items.whyUz: 'it' uchun ham IS/ISN'T.

items.textEn: Are we playing? — Yes, ............ / No, we aren't.
items.whyUz: 'Yes, we are.' — qisqartmasiz.

items.textEn: Are you playing? (ko'plik) — Yes, you are. / No, ............
items.whyUz: 'you' birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham bir xil: are / aren't.

items.textEn: Are they playing? — Yes, they are. / No, ............
items.whyUz: 'aren't' = are not.

groups.explanationUz: Bitta URG'ULI unli + bitta undosh bilan tugasa, undosh ikkilanadi.
Fe'l -e bilan tugasa, e tushib qoladi.
Ko'p sport va mashg'ulotlar 'go' fe'li bilan aytiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: She's playing football now. They are making a snowman.
patterns.exampleUz: U hozir futbol o'ynayapti. Ular qorbobo yasashayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: 'to be' egaga qarab o'zgaradi, fe'l esa doim -ING bilan.

patterns.exampleEn: She isn't eating an ice-cream at the moment.
patterns.explanationUz: Inkor 'be' fe'liga qo'shiladi, asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: Is he playing? Are they playing?

patterns.formula: Yes, + ega + be (TO'LIQ). / No, + ega + qisqargan inkor.
patterns.exampleEn: Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
patterns.explanationUz: Tasdiq javobda qisqartma ISHLATILMAYDI: 'Yes, he's' XATO.

patterns.formula: What's the temperature in + shahar? — It's + son + °C/°F.
patterns.exampleEn: What's the temperature in Cairo today? — It's 25°C. / It's 77°F.

patterns.formula: When it is + ob-havo, you can + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: When it is snowy you can ski or make a snowman.
patterns.exampleUz: Qorli bo'lganda chang'i uchish yoki qorbobo yasash mumkin.
patterns.explanationUz:
'when' — vaqt bog'lovchisi.
'can' dan keyin fe'l asos shaklida.
